{{Quote|I can't begin to give you a full list of tyrants like Nom Anor that I've dealt with.''"<br />"''I have that very list available. Tonkoss Rathba of&mdash;|Leia Organa Solo and C-3PO|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
'''Tonkoss Rathba''' was a being who was dictator of [[Daluba]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] had been involved in diplomacy with Rathba some time prior to the [[Osarian-Rhommamool conflict]]<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime" /> in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'' to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> and she considered Rathba to be something of a tyrant. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] compared Rathba to [[Icknya]] and [[Nom Anor]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime" />
